decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - Full details to include samples of the following:                                                                       (a) stone copings to all extenstions                                                                             (b) rainwater goods                                                                                                     (c) natural slates                                                                                               shall be submitted to and agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the commencement of works and the approved details shall be implemented and maintained thereafter.
Condition : 2 - Full details shall be submitted of the following internal features listed below:                              (a) Fireplace to basement room

Condition : 3 - Sample panels of brickworks showing the proposed colour, texture, face-bond and pointing shall be provided on site and approved by the Local Planning Authority before the works are commenced and the sample panels shall be retained on site until the work is completed and has been approved.

Condition : 4 - Construction details (to include sections) at scale 1:5 or as appropriate of the following:                                                                                                                                    (a) dormer window to the flank elevation                                                                       (b) the ground floor rear window                                                                                   (c) the new garage doors, brackets and lintel                                                                (d) rear and flank parapet detail                                                                                   (e) the gap between the rear basement extension and No.54.                                                                                                                                                                        shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority before the commencement of works.
Condition : 5 - All external joinery shall be of painted timber.
Condition : 6 - No plumbing or pipes, other than rainwater pipes, or vents shall be fixed on the external faces pof the building unless shown on the approved drawings.

Condition : 7 - Submission of conditions 1 - 11 must be made not later than the expiration of three months beginning with the date of this consent. The development shall not be carried out  otherwise than in accordance with the submitted details thus approved, and shall be completed within 6 months of the date of this consent or such extended time which must first be approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 8 - Demolition of the rear wall and construction of the new rear wall shall be completed within 5 months after the submission and approval of reserved matters by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 9 - No development shall take place until plans at scale 1:5 (or as appropriate) for the rear elevation and also the mansard roof have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and these works shall be carried out as approved.

Condition : 10 - No development shall take place until the height of the rear basement extension has been submitted, agreed on site and approved by the Local Planning Authority and these works shall be carried out as approved.

Condition : 11 - Notwithstanding the information shown on submitted drawing 835/H the brick slips shall extend above the top window in accordance with a scheme at scale 1:20 of the whole elevations to be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority before the works hereby approved are commenced. Sample panels of brick slips showing the proposed colour, texture, face-bond and pointing shall be provided on site and approved by the Local Planning Authority before the works are commenced and the sample panels shall be retained on site until the work has been completed and has been approved.
description: Partial demolition of rear wall and parapet plus retention of side extension to basement, ground and first floors and single storey rear extension to basement incorporating internal and external alterations.  (Listed Building)
